title: South Philly Supper Club
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately - rain ponchos will be given out on rainy days
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a night out centered around great food at 
Chef Jacquie’s favorite spaces with a small group, featuring chef insights, insider stories, on a fun foodie journey.

Along the way, you will make new friends, eat great food and dive into lively conversations centered around the 5 BIG F’s — food, folklore, film, friends, and family — the heart and soul of South Philly life.

Welcome: Start at Alice with a glass of wine and a delectable bite — the perfect way to kick off the evening.

Sips & Bites: Next, stop into Di Bruno Bros. Bottle Shop for sips, charcuterie and pick up a bottle of wine for dinner.

Dinner & Dessert: Stroll over to Angelina's Restaurant for handmade pastas just like nonna used to make, appetizer, and warm crusty bread. Finish with a classic cannoli from Isgro Pastries and a sweet treat — all part of our friendly supper club–style experience built around great food and shared moments at the table.
